# ImaginaryGaugePhaseImprint

**Domain**: Cross
**First mentioned**: auto-extracted
**Last updated**: 2026-08-04

## Definition
A method to imprint a spatially varying imaginary gauge phase onto wavefunctions in non-Hermitian lattices, enabling arbitrary wavefunction configuration. Provides a new degree of freedom for shaping wavefunctions, which could be leveraged for programmable signal routing or state encoding in neuromorphic photonic hardware.
